message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts: The defendant destroyed a loader and a diesel engine of a sand mining operation with a hammer, causing damage valued at 32,601 yuan. He did it out of personal grievance after his farmland was damaged by the sand mining. He later compensated 30,000 yuan. The prosecution says he intentionally destroyed property, amount large, violating Criminal Law. So the crime is "故意毁坏财物罪" (Intentional destruction of property). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 275 (or 275? Actually article 275 is "故意毁坏公私财物罪" maybe article 275). The amount is "数额较大" qualifies for criminal liability. So the appropriate charge is "故意毁坏财物罪". No other crimes like theft, fraud, etc. So answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物罪<eoa>.

Check if any other possible: Could be "寻衅滋事罪"? But the facts are about property damage, not public order. The main is intentional property damage. So single crime.

Thus final answer.
